notes.content:
[h1]v0.0.10[/h1]

[h2]🔥 New Features[/h2]

[list]
  [*] Changed the game speed, now the bullet speed is faster. By a lot
  [*] Added Galilar rifle
  [*] Added Famas rifle
  [*] Added Deagle pistol
  [*] Added MP9 SMG
  [*] Space now centers the camera on the character
  [list]
    [*] And now crosshair thanks to Kugel :)
  [/list]
[/list]
[list]
  [*] 😠 cry-over-here-netoca
  [list]
    [*] USP now have a higher recoil
    [*] Famas nerfed by a bit
    [*] Changed how De_Metro works, removed CT door to see multiple rooms at once
    [*] Still crashing, sorry :(
  [/list]
[/list]
[list]
  [*] Added voice acting to be used in missions, same voice can be pitched into multiple characters
  [list]
    [*] Luna voice
    [*] Rafal voice
  [/list]
  [*] Added dialogue system
  [*] Added mission sequencer ( ways to progress a mission )
  [list]
    [*] Added bot spawner
    [*] Added bomb target
    [*] Added interactable target
    [*] Added pickable target
  [/list]
[/list]
[list]
  [*] Added new Mapping tools! This will be useful to create the next maps
[/list]

[h2]🛠 Fixes & Improvements[/h2]
[list]
  [*] Decals are now applied to vertical walls ( beta )
  [*] Nerfed USP... again
  [*] De_Construction map now have a more open A and a more Closed B
[/list]

[list]
  [*] Refactor bot behavior and enhance mission objectives
    [list]
      [*] Removed obsolete properties from bot spawn point configuration.
      [*] Introduced natural movement system for bots, improving their navigation and behavior.
      [*] Updated bot behavior scripts to include new combat patterns and patrol systems.
      [*] Enhanced mission objectives with improved dialogue handling and attention grabbing.
      [*] Adjusted various parameters for better gameplay experience and bot interactions.
    [/list]
[/list]


[h2]🗑 Removed[/h2]

[list]
  [*] Disable TTS
  [list]
    [*] New TTS is coming!
  [/list]
[/list]

notes.title: v0.0.9
notes.content:
[h2]🔥 New Features[/h2]

[list]

  [*] [b]128 Tickrate Servers[/b]  

[/list]

  Servers now run at 128 tickrate, offering more responsive gameplay at the cost of higher network usage.

[list]

  [*] [b]New Weapon: SG553[/b]  

  [list]

    [*] Available to Terrorists.  

    [*] Effective at long range and in 1v1 scenarios, but underperforms in 1vX situations.

  [/list]

[/list]

[list]

  [*] [b]New Grenade: Decoy[/b]  

  [list]

    [*] Emits sounds mimicking your held weapon.  

    [*] Useful for misleading enemies and creating tactical distractions.

  [/list]

[/list]

[list]

  [*] [b]Unique Buy Menus in Bomb Mode[/b]  

  [list]

    [*] Counter-Terrorists and Terrorists now have distinct buy options, enhancing economic and gameplay differences between the teams.

  [/list]

[/list]

[list]

  [*] [b]UI Audio Enhancements[/b]  

  [list]

    [*] Added satisfying new sound effects to the menu interface.

  [/list]

[/list]

[h2]🛠 Fixes & Improvements[/h2]

[list]

  [*] [b]Map Changes[/b]

  [list]

    [*] Rebalanced [b]De_Metro[/b].

    [*] Adjusted [b]De_Construction[/b]:  

    [list]

      [*] Fixed hitbox issues on the car.  

      [*] Redesigned long and catwalk areas for better flow.

    [/list]

  [/list]

[/list]

[list]

  [*] [b]Gameplay Tweaks[/b]

  [list]

    [*] [b]HE Grenade[/b] now applies a strong slowing effect, turning it into more of a utility tool rather than pure damage.

    [*] Default camera and aiming behavior now uses snapping for improved control.

  [/list]

[/list]

[list]

  [*] [b]Weapon Balance[/b]

  [list]

    [*] [b]M4A1[/b] price reduced: 3100 → 2900  

    [*] [b]SG553[/b] price set to 3000  

    [*] [b]AUG[/b] price set to 3300  

    [*] [b]Elephant Gun[/b] reworked: now functions like a Scout (SG) and costs 1700

  [/list]

[/list]

[list]

  [*] Fix damage sound being played to EVERYONE

  [*] Now HUB is under construction

[/list]

[h2]🗑 Removed[/h2]

[list]

  [*] Removed enemy death ping marker

  [*] Removed ally death ping marker

[/list]

notes.title: v0.0.8
notes.content:
[h2]🔥 New Features[/h2]
[list]
  [*] AWP now requires aiming for precision
  [*] Added screenshake config
  [*] Map Callouts
  [list]
    [*] Under the minimap you can see where you are and communicate with your teammates
  [/list]
  [*] Kevlar
  [list]
    [*] Armor Penetration
    [list]
      [*] Now every bullet caliber have a different armor penetration
      [*] All weapons with no exception got rebalanced due to this new change
    [/list]
  [/list]
  [*] Helmet
  [list]
    [*] With helmet, depending on the weapon caliber you can survive a lethal shot ( and loose your helmet on the way )
  [/list]
  [*] Reworked Buy Menu! Still the same but more stylish, centered, more useful info, organization and you can buy equips! Not only weapons
  [*] Now trace weapons have distance falloff damage, like projectile ones
  [list]
    [*] This effectively nerfs USP ( and nerfs Kugel by a lot )
  [/list]
[/list]


[h2]🛠 Fixes & Improvements[/h2]
[list]
  [*] Balanced all weapons
  [*] Fixed a bug where after you were flashbanged you could not aim anymore
  [*] Fixed a bug where you could open inventory on pause
  [*] Fixed a bug where you could open EMOJIS on pause
  [*] Fixed a bug where stop aiming made you stop walking
  [*] Fixed a bug where you could not press ESC on HUB
  [*] Fixed mouse not showing on end-game screens
  [*] Add death feedback
  [*] Fixed spawn cycle of characters in all gamemodes (except Hordes)
  [*] Fixed name tag not synchronizing with the character name - "Name"
  [*] Fixed name tag not always showing on mouse over (clint)
  [*] Fixed chat needing double enter to appear
  [*] We now move the player camera arround the map before the round starts
  [*] Player will not open the buy menu without character anymore
  [*] Player now auto-spectates on death
  [*] Waiting for other player screens while waiting for other players on bomb
  [*] Economy money will not be shown on bomb while the round is not started
  [*] Players are now able to spectate one another right after join
  [*] Buy zones now have specific teams
  [*] Adds a Winning Team screen on the end of game
  [*] Fixes team chat showing to other team
  [*] Team chat now paints the player team color
  [*] Player teams are now always synchronized properly
  [*] You are now able to close chat with a single enter
  [*] Camera does not say 'ciau Italy' anymore
  [*] Fixes kill feed not showing on dead characters
[/list]


[h2]🗑 Removed[/h2]
[list]
  [*] Removed granade spreads and recoil
  [*] Removed BAZOOKA spreads and recoil
[/list]

notes.title: v0.0.6
notes.content:
Check the full update: [url=https://plano-b.site/blog/7]PL4no-B Blog[/url]

The infame UI overhaul, Online Services, some features and bug fixes. Here's what's new:

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🔥 New Features[/h2]

[list]
  [*] [b]UI[/b] We have a proper map loading screen that shows the map and objectives
  [*] [b]UI[/b] We updated our components to a more tactical vibe to have a visual identity
  [*] [b]Camera[/b] Added new Camera Type: SNAP, a super resposible camera that snaps to the crosshair. Good for powerplayers, still in beta, since camera shake gives some headache
  [*] [b]UI[/b] Added game version in the screen
  [*] [b]Match & Ranking System[/b] Overhauled match entry, ranking menus, and user data handling for better consistency and feedback.
  [*] [b]PL4no-B Online Service[/b]
  [*] ELO Rating System
  [list]
    [*] Implemented ELO rating tracking for matches.
  [/list]
[/list]

[list]
  [*] Ranking System
  [list]
    [*] Introduced a basic ranking system tied to player ELO scores.
  [/list]
[/list]

[list]
  [*] Match Lifecycle Enhancements
  [list]
    [*] Improved match creation and validation with new fields such as MATCH_PROCESSING status.
    [*] Player validation during match start and reporting.
    [*] Added player management functionality within the match model.
    [*] Added routes for joining and leaving matches.
  [/list]
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🛠 Fixes & Improvements[/h2]
[list]
  [*] [b]Fixed bug[/b] Spawning on destruction would have infinite weapon zoom
  [list]
    [*] 🗨 Reported by [b]Netoca/Pepoca/Pepo/[/b]
  [/list]
  [*] [b]Fixed bug[/b] Spawning on destruction would have wrong hands (always CT)
  [list]
    [*] 🗨 Reported by [b]Netoca/Pepoca/Pepo/[/b]
  [/list]
  [*] [b]UI[/b]
  [list]
    [*] Added new UI components such as MenuButton, MenuSlider, MenuToggle, and country flag icons.
    [*] Improved visual design and usability across home, settings, multiplayer, and loading menus.
  [/list]
  [*] [b]SFX[/b]
  [list]
    [*] Added and updated background music themes for different times of day (e.g., hub[i]morning[/i]theme, hub[i]night[/i]theme) and improved sound effects like intro.mp3.
  [/list]
  [*] [b]Bug[/b] Characters duplicating on spawned fixed
  [list]
    [*] 🗨 Reported by [b]Netoca/Syed/Kugel[/b]
  [/list]
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🗑 Removed[/h2]
[list]
  [*] Free-cam was removed to inhibit unfair advantages
[/list]

notes.title: Friday Bits #03
notes.content:
Hey guys! Von Bonin here,

Today I’d like to show you the utility side of our game—the strategy, the finesse, which are the grenades. I’m running a little late, but still managed to get this update written in time for the weekend family gathering.

As for the weapons, I’m also planning on adding some more grenades in the future, and I’m open to suggestions as always—so feel free to reach out at any point!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45473614/653251fade1bd24260b87fb5c5243bcc42fbc8a9.png[/img]

The current game has 4 types of grenades:
- [b]Hand grenades[/b], which explode on impact
- [b]Flashbangs[/b], for those delicious white screens
- [b]Smoke grenades[/b], which create a curtain you cannot see through
- [b]Molotovs[/b], for setting things on fire—including yourself

These 4 grenades are expected to become 6 in the future, with the addition of a [b]sound decoy grenade[/b] as well as a [b]flare grenade[/b], which lets you see an area you normally would not have vision of.

All these grenades have strategic uses and situations. For example, I often like to use molotovs to set the bombsite on fire when the bomb is about to explode as the Red Team—or to block an opposing team’s rush into a bombsite.

Here are some pictures with the visual effect of each one so you are able to know what to expect in each case.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45473614/6ac9a3c35f73fc6951516d5c5a71e4e0549fe39c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45473614/657f88bb29a711ad27154284369652fcdd4782dd.png[/img]

I recommend that you boot up the game and experiment during matches to see which grenades best suit your playstyle. Since you can carry up to 4 grenades at a time, there’s plenty of room to experiment and be strategic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45473614/ea684fe8eaa8d9bba21fc405d4125bea8801f6c3.png[/img]

Ah, there’s also a trail that shows where your grenade will land (when you’re not moving or running, of course), which helps you use them more effectively.

And that’s it—fast, quick, and furious. Don't forget to feed the fire mage.
I wish you a great weekend, and until next week,
Von Bonin

notes.title: Friday Bits #02
notes.content:
Hey guys! Von Bonin here,

Today, I want to take a moment to showcase the weapons currently available in the game. Each weapon has been designed with a unique playstyle in mind—whether you're into precision, raw power, CQC, sniping, or, like my friend Sied Muhamed, PURE UNFILTERED CHAOS.

More weapons are on the way in future updates, and I’d love to hear your ideas. Got a weapon in mind? I might just add it (especially if it’s cursed).

[h2]Intermission[/h2]
This curated review is proudly sponsored by the [b]Fire Mage[/b] (please keep him happy by pretending his molotov is a real fire spell).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45473614/18e5d9e9d8bb1c3bccde9993c9952543ddbf1937.png[/img]

The Fire Mage also insists I tell you that each weapon has some distinctive features, including:
- [b]Bullet size[/b]
- [b]Damage[/b]
- [b]Spread[/b]
- [b]Slow applied[/b]
- [b]Speed while holding[/b]

These variations enable a lot of dynamic play. For example, you can hold a knife to run faster to a point of interest and then switch to your real weapon—or fire a slowing weapon first, before delivering the actual damage.

[h2]Rifles[/h2]
Rifles offer some of the longest ranges and highest damage output, making them ideal for mid-to-long range combat. These weapons are designed for precision and power, rewarding players who can better control recoil instead of just spraying and praying.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45473614/37c1e24d03967d53610cc619060196c1306ecb9c.png[/img]

The current lineup includes:
- [b]AK-47[/b], the old reliable. Loud, proud, and deadly.
- [b]M4A1[/b], the good guy AK-47
- [b]AUG[/b], best weapon. Will need a nerf at some point... eventually… maybe.

Each weapon brings its own strengths and weaknesses. However, if you’re not a rifle guy but still like full-auto, prefer a more aggressive approach, and don’t want to think too hard—we have SMGs!

[h2]SMGs[/h2]
For players who hear an echo when they think. Most bullets. Most fun. Just hold W and click.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45473614/921ae5ce54e05e81ee42a1e1b33e3de9bbf373b7.png[/img]

The current lineup includes:
- [b]P90[/b], RUSH B CYKA.
- [b]NEGEV[/b], initially a dev weapon used to test network syncing and performance by pushing the game to its limits. Now included for 64 players to pick up and see who has the better PC.

[h2]Shotguns[/h2]
Shotguns are built for close-quarters combat. Massive damage. Massive vibes. Just run into a room and delete people.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45473614/fea5c5c3164a7707608a99b33b6783cf86fa893a.png[/img]

The current lineup includes:
- [b]NOVA[/b], also known as “Why aren’t you dead?! I hit you twice!”
- [b]SPAS12[/b], If you hear it cock and you're not already shooting… it’s over.

I usually prefer to stalk players around corner turns with these bad boys. However, you’ll need to find your own playstyle with them.

[h2]Pistols[/h2]
Pistols are versatile, precise, and great at mid-to-close range combat. They offer more range than shotguns while remaining lightweight and accurate. This means you can walk and shoot without worrying too much about recoil or spread. Depending on the pistol type, they can function as a backup weapon or a precise tool for skilled players.

Pistols in the game come in two categories:
- [b]Trace-based[/b], hits instantly. Low damage. Great for sniping some chip damage.
- [b]Projectile-based[/b], slower shots, but way more Oof.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45473614/8f61c24fbfb9078e04ea4c8b6a1b2a8055052c5a.png[/img]

The current lineup includes:
- [b]GLONK[/b], GLONK
- [b]KRUGER[/b], balanced. Like all things should be.
- [b]REVOLVER[/b], high damage, big drama.
- [b]USP[/b], silenced and tactical. Smells like a covert op.
- [b]HAND CANNON[/b], … why did we implement this MONSTER?? Seriously.

Each pistol has its strengths, offering different playstyles and strategies. Let me know if you have any suggestions for the current setup or want to see other pistols included.

[h2]Snipers[/h2]
Sniper rifles are designed for long-range precision, rewarding patience and accuracy.

Currently, the only sniper rifle available is:
- [b]AWP[/b], if you’ve played Counter-Strike, you already know. If you haven’t… you will.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45473614/7665d6ffb1e786fc8883418d371e99122b826581.png[/img]

I’m working on adding a second sniper—maybe a semi-auto or something fast like the DRAGON-9. Stay tuned, and please do suggest more.

[h2]Melee[/h2]
Melee is not just about stabbing—it’s about sending a message. Nothing makes an enemy panic more than seeing someone sprinting at them with a katana in hand. The fear causes them to run, and by running, they miss their shots—giving you the upper hand in close quarters… unless, of course, they’re holding a [b]BAZOOKA[/b] or [b]SPAS12[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45473614/15c475de390f84df6cd3388f26549b9813ac542a.png[/img]

Right now, the only melee weapon available is the [b]MACHETE[/b], but we’re planning to add a [b]SWORD[/b], [b]KNIFE[/b], [b]STONE[/b], [b]HANDS[/b], and [b]THROWING AXE[/b] in a future update. Each will bring its own playstyle, whether it’s speed, reach, or raw power. Got an idea? Pitch it. The weirder, the better.

[h2]Special Weapons[/h2]
Special weapons add a level of chaos that changes the pace of a fight. Usually, they were designed just to test the game, but since they’re super fun, we decided to keep them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45473614/db9e87bc187692b5becdd7c6dc0d0ac163da20f7.png[/img]

We’ve got the [b]RPG-7[/b], the [b]ELEPHANT GUN[/b], [b]GRENADE LAUNCHERS[/b], and a few others. These weapons are as fun as they are destructive, leading to some ridiculous moments in combat.

There’s more to discover—but you’ll have to play to find out.

Take care,
Von Bonin

notes.title: Friday Bits #01
notes.content:
Hey guys! [b]Von Bonin[/b] here,

My friend and I were tired of working a 9-5 just to come home and clock into our second job—grinding Counter-Strike for another 9-5 just to stay competitive. We wanted a way to capture that awesome Counter-Strike experience but in a more relaxed, casual setting. That’s when we had an incredible idea—to combine the American Dream with our laid-back mindset and create a game where every player has a gun, plants bombs, and shoots their friends. And so, this is what we came up with:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45473614/7d1af6dc4e4664aefaa978f6ee72763c77a08f53.png[/img]

What started as a side project quickly evolved into a full-scale multiplayer game on Steam, and we’ve been working hard to bring it to life. Right now, we’re preparing a detailed roadmap for you, but here’s a sneak peek at what you can expect when the game is ready:
- Casual Deathmatch Mode 
- Co-op Horde/Extraction Mode
- Classic Bomb-Planting Mode
- Sandbox mode to test new weapons and tactics
- Public HUBs & Social Spaces to build new relationships
- Base Building & Progression 
- Steam Item Collection & Trading 
- Tons and tons of fun

We’ll be posting continuous updates to share our progress and showcase new features as we build them. Stay tuned for more exciting news! Follow us on our socials to stay updated!

Looking forward to sharing this journey with you all. See you in the game!

Take care,
Von Bonin
